# nico_ssh_key (Data Source)

SSH Key is a public key that can be used to access the Serial Console of an Instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_ssh_key" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "ssh_key_name" {
  value = data.nico_ssh_key.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `query` (String) Search for matches across all SSH Keys. Input will be matched against the name field
- `ssh_key_group_id` (String) ID of the SSH Key Group

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was created
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the public key
- `name` (String) Name of the SSHKey
- `org` (String) Organization the SSHKey belongs to
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the SSH key was last updated
